digest.component_or_area: grounding scan test harness and external analyzer integration
propositions: Real external analyzer invocations (OpenGrep, ast-grep, gitleaks, Ctags) must each retain at least one explicit boundary test covering tool-present, tool-absent, timeout, invalid-output, rule-discovery, and evidence-accounting behaviors before any cross-test result reuse or fixture consolidation is permitted.

Call-local OpenGrep YAML source-path validation caching can eliminate duplicate semgrep --validate invocations within _run_opengrep without crossing test boundaries, projected to save ~5.9s per matched scan pair.

Pytest-xdist worker-local fixture scope prevents session-scoped scan-result reuse across workers under -n 3 --dist worksteal; any full reuse benefit requires explicit cross-process immutable artifact caching or test-boundary consolidation approved by operator.

Fault-seeded equivalence matrix must enumerate exact-defect tests for each failure mode (discovery, tool presence/absence, timeout, invalid detector, invalid output, path quarantine, evidence normalization, consumer fail-open/fail-closed) and verify every removed invocation has a matched detecting oracle.

Real analyzer tools (Semgrep 1.172.0, ast-grep 0.45.1, gitleaks 8.30.1, Ctags 6.2.1) are not CI-guaranteed on Ubuntu runners; macOS 57.7-second measured reuse savings cannot be extrapolated to aggregate CI claim without verified tool presence on all platforms.
